name: revenue
label: Revenue
sql: SELECT SUM(CAST("Booking Value" AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS revenue FROM uber_ncr.ncr_ride_bookings WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed'
anti_patterns: Never count the booking value of cancelled or incomplete rides

name: completed_rides
label: Completed rides
sql: SELECT COUNT("Booking ID") AS completed_rides FROM uber_ncr.ncr_ride_bookings WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Completed'
anti_patterns: Never count a booking that was cancelled by the customer or the driver

name: customer_cancellation_rate
label: Customer cancellation rate
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Booking Status" = 'Cancelled by Customer') * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS customer_cancellation_rate FROM uber_ncr.ncr_ride_bookings
description: Share of bookings the customer cancelled.
anti_patterns: Never average daily rates — divide the period's cancellations by its bookings

name: revenue
label: Revenue
sql: SELECT SUM(totalPrice) AS revenue FROM main.sales_transactions
anti_patterns: Never add unitPrice — totalPrice already carries the quantity

name: average_order_value
label: Average order value
sql: SELECT SUM(totalPrice) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT transactionID) AS average_order_value FROM main.sales_transactions
anti_patterns: Never average the per-line totals — a transaction with many lines would count many times
